jobs.title: Learning Operations Manager - Walton, KY
jobs.description:
﻿

The Learning Operations Manager influences with a focus on safety, leadership, excellence, self-motivation, problem-solving and teamwork. This role will enable employees to develop the knowledge, skill, behaviors and experience they need to achieve their goals and progress their career. Partner with DC operations and our Learning & Development team to deliver results. This role will be responsible for facilitating training programs while coaching and holding your operational-leader partners accountable for their success.

Job Responsibility
• Acts as an engaging and inclusive leader who will develop and implement training content for the assigned DC. (35%)
• Communicates and oversees the execution of training at all levels by DC, maintaining strategic partnerships with the entire DC, other DCs and various SSC partners. (20%)
• Creates strategies to balance short- and long-term business plans. (10%)
• Fosters the development and growth of employees and leaders in assigned DC. (10%)
• Works closely with the SSC’s Learning & Development team and the Human Resources teams to ensure standard training programs are properly designed and consistently implemented (5%)
• Selects, evaluates, and develops Training Coordinators (5%)
• Coaches managers on developing leadership skills in their supervisors. (5%)
• Assists DC management with organizational development plans. (5%)
• Analyzes and understands data to measure the training program performance within the DC. (5%)

Job Qualifications
• Thorough working knowledge of distribution center
• Good reasoning, conflict-management, and analytical and problem-solving skills
• Understanding of training design and needs analysis
• Understanding of performance development, team development, and leadership development processes; demonstrated developmental approach to leadership
• Ability to evaluate supervisory and management employees for leadership potential
• Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills with all levels of the organization
• Able to read and interpret necessary policies and procedures to perform updates and operate systems and other programs within the Distribution Center.

Education/Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in education or human resource development preferred.
• Two to four years' experience in employee training and development or in a human resources position with employee development emphasis.


Drives employee development by facilitating training programs and coaching operational leaders to ensure success. Partners with distribution center operations and Learning & Development teams to build skills, foster leadership, and promote a culture of safety and excellence.

jobs.title: Process Improvement Manager - Corp
jobs.description:
Job Details Duties & Responsibilities:
- Lead and support key cross functional and strategic projects using structured project management methodologies that deliver significant value to Dollar General.
Define project scope, timelines, milestones, resources, and success metrics. Ensure alignment with business priorities and track progress against established plans.
- Apply formal project management practices, including project planning, status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
Maintain clear documentation and ensure consistent execution standards across projects.
- Rigorously support the identification, evaluation, implementation and execution of processes that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Dollar General.
Support strategic planning, process review and improvement projects to enhance corporate performance.
- Analyze processes and performance through data collection, time studies, and productivity assessments.
Identify root causes, evaluate improvement opportunities, and recommend actionable solutions to optimize performance.
- Partner with Supply Chain, Store Operations, Merchandising and other department leadership in the development and deployment of process improvement initiatives.
Work with IT, Finance, and other support functions to remove constraints, justify investments and implement solutions that improve service and reduce expense.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):
- Ability to quickly identify potential drivers of emerging problems, root cause, and generate solutions.

- Ability to partner, coordinate and influence across all levels of management.

- Ability to prioritize projects based on solution impact, time to implement and/or direction from leadership.

- Ability to lead multiple priorities and projects (3-5).

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across all levels of the organization.

- Design and execute appropriate analyses to size potential impact of problems or solutions.

- Strong analytical and process mapping skills.

- Knowledge of project management methodologies.

- Ability to create and execute an implementation plan for rollout.

Job Qualifications

Work Experience &/or Education:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain or Industrial Engineering required, or equivalent professional experience.

- Advanced Degree preferred.

- Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience.

- Project Management (PMP Certification), Industrial engineering, Six Sigma, and/or Lean Six Sigma experience preferred.

jobs.title: STORE OPERATIONS MANAGER
jobs.description:
﻿

Owns and/or delivers financial/operational analysis on store operations projects. This may include regular weekly and monthly reporting, metric trending, data mining and development of business cases, and associated benefits. Additionally, assists with ad hoc analyses and support of other projects and departments as requested.

Job Responsibility
Analytics and Reporting (50%)
• Leverages multiple internal systems to perform detailed analyses, identify trends or expectations, and support issue resolution.
• Designs, maintains, and manages reporting scorecards that track operations metrics, task management performance, and communication tool adoption for leadership review.
• Conducts process and applications audits; builds measurement tools to analyze current processes and recommend improvements or new solutions.
• Identifies and pursues process improvement opportunities with a focus on reducing waste and enabling automation.

Project Management (30%)
• Develops and manages project plans to monitor progress and status updates for key projects and test-and-learn initiatives.
• Captures detailed requirements for enhancement requires and formalizes documentations for tool and process development or optimization.
• Performs field observations to gather insights support process mapping, and assess the impact of process changes.

Communication (20%)
• Develops presentations, communications, and training materials for leadership updates, product enhancement rollout, cross-functional initiatives, and training sessions.
• Provides field support through diagnostic troubleshooting for software applications and oversees user access management for internal tool.

Job Qualifications
• Demonstrates a knowledge of retail operations, merchandising and financial software and databases.
• Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills with an ability to meet deadlines.
• Familiar with reading, writing, and editing programming languages such as SQL, XML, and Visual Basic.
• Experience with data mining and database management tool like PowerPivot, Power Quiery, Alteryx, and/or 1010data to identify opportunities through root cause analysis, develop actionable solutions and reports, and execute required plans.
• Highly proficient at MS Office products, especially PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and Outlook.
• Familiar with reading, writing, and editing programming languages such as SQL, XML, and Visual Basic.
• Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to summarize data into reports and presentations for senior leadership

Education/Experience
Bachelor’s degree required with a 4-6 years of experience minimum of 2 – 4 years of work experience in an analyst role. Master’s degree in Business preferred. Retail work experience a plus.
